properties.geological_substrate: Cairngorms granitic bedrock overlaid with glacial till, podzolic soils, and peat layers in the Strathspey basin
properties.ground_plane: Compacted gravel farm tracks, dirt access roads, and undulating pastureland with drainage swales

built_envelope.farm_complex: Agricultural steading complex with corrugated sheet steel and profiled metal pitched roofs, roughcast harled masonry and timber-clad walls, low-pitch gabled sheds and outbuildings
built_envelope.rectification_needs: Sharpen melting rooflines and eaves on agricultural sheds, plumb vertical harled facades, planarize distorted ground footprint

properties.landscape_ecology: Open Highland moorland and pasture, patches of heather (*Calluna vulgaris*), Scot's pine (*Pinus sylvestris*) fringes, and the Monadhliath mountain ridgeline across the western horizon

lighting_atmosphere.color_temperature: 3100K warm amber raking light with long eastward-cast shadows and cool indigo ambient haze over distant ridges
